“Magicians. I’m comfortable with the Deck and I feel like it gives me the best odds to win.” -
“Pendulum Magicians. It is really versatile and I don’t think people are prepared.” -Kesavan Kushahagar
“Link Infernoids. It is a strong Deck going first and second.” -
“World Chalice. It was the only Deck I could put together in time.” -
“Pendulums. I haven’t played that Deck in a while and it’s pretty powerful.” -
“Palozoics because I didn’t have the cards to build Pendulums.” -
“Magician Pendulum. My friend let me borrow it.” -
“I’m using ABC because it’s all that I had and felt comfortable with.” -
“Draco Demise with Spellbooks. I think it’s going to win.” -
